tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
ASUS PRIME B760M-K D4 Micro-ATX Motherboard (Intel 12th/13th/14th Gen, DDR4, LGA 1700)

The ASUS PRIME B760M-K D4 is a reliable and efficient motherboard designed for Intel's 12th, 13th, and 14th Gen Core processors, offering a solid foundation for everyday computing, business systems, or entry-level gaming builds. Built on the Intel B760 chipset and featuring the LGA 1700 socket, it supports DDR4 memory and delivers essential features in a compact Micro-ATX form factor.

Equipped with PCIe 4.0 support, M.2 NVMe slots, and USB 3.2 connectivity, the motherboard provides fast data transfers and smooth system responsiveness. ASUS’s 5X Protection III ensures long-term durability and stability with safeguards like overvoltage protection and reinforced PCIe slots.

  • Supports Intel 12th, 13th & 14th Gen CPUs (LGA 1700)
  • Dual DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 64GB memory
  • PCIe 4.0 x16 slot for modern graphics cards
  • M.2 and SATA ports for fast storage options
  • USB 3.2 Gen 1 support for faster data transfers
  • Micro-ATX form factor, ideal for space-efficient builds
  • ASUS 5X Protection III for enhanced durability
